title: Stats
description: A player's needs and condition. Every stat is an integer 0–100 where 100 is best, so games can compare without knowing each other's internals.
fallback: A receiver ignores stats it does not model. It never invents a value for a stat the sender did not send.
extension: Stats cannot be extended with x- names: they cross games in souvenirs, so a new stat needs an SEP.

terms.label: Energy
terms.description: Rested and alert. Sleep raises it; work and exercise drain it.

terms.label: Fed
terms.description: How well fed the player is: 100 is full, 0 is starving. Eating raises it. (Read it as "fed".)

terms.label: Mood
terms.description: Overall emotional state, the sum of how life is going.

terms.label: Social
terms.description: How connected the player feels. Talking and company raise it; isolation drains it.

terms.label: Hygiene
terms.description: Clean and fresh. Washing raises it; work, exercise and travel drain it.

terms.label: Fitness
terms.description: Physical condition, which changes slowly. Exercise raises it.

terms.label: Fun
terms.description: Entertained rather than bored. Play, music and nights out raise it; chores and work drain it.

terms.label: Bladder
terms.description: Comfort: 100 means no need for the toilet, 0 means urgent. Using a toilet raises it.
